scope: Stage 3; fixed before running the revised calibration evaluation

methods.Raw: stored raw sigmoid probability, checked against replayed checkpoint logits
methods.Bayes: sigmoid(logit - log(float32 training positive-class loss weight))
methods.ShiftTemp: sigmoid((logit - log(float32 training positive-class loss weight)) / T_shift)

fourth_method: One fitted temperature after a fixed training-weight offset; not unrestricted two-parameter affine Platt scaling
logit_source: CPU float32 canonical checkpoint replay with saved preprocessing; no inverse of clipped CSV probabilities
bounds_reason: Retain pre-existing bounds, report boundary solutions explicitly; do not tune against official tests
objective: unweighted calibration binary cross entropy, evaluated stably directly on logits

cross_validation.group_unit: engine; require exactly one calibration endpoint per engine
cross_validation.fallback: if minority count < 2, no CV estimate; report unavailable. Single-class calibration fails explicitly
cross_validation.purpose: out-of-fold calibration diagnostics only; no method or hyperparameter selection
cross_validation.official_test_probabilities: refit each temperature once on all calibration engines; do not average fold calibrators

metrics: per-run Brier and 10 equal-width-bin ECE including p=1; subset mean and sample SD (ddof=1)
selection: Report all four methods in all 20 runs; no per-subset choice from official-test scores
limitation: Retrospective remediation of a benchmark whose test scores have already been inspected; CV does not prove absence of overfitting or erase prior test exposure
